name: epoch-exhausted
why: the recorded epoch's allowance is spent; the control for the rewind below

name: epoch-rewind
why: THE EXPLOIT. claimedDaa is agent-supplied and bounded below only, so an earlier epoch used to reset spentThisEpoch to zero and hand back the whole allowance, repeatably. The per-epoch cap limited nothing.

name: epoch-forward
why: a LATER epoch legitimately carries a fresh allowance; the ratchet must not block it

name: epoch-same-headroom
why: the recorded epoch with room left is an ordinary spend

name: past-expiry
why: a claimedDaa at or beyond expiresAt. The spend path had no expiry check at all.

name: revoke-honest
why: an ordinary revoke, paying the principal and a normal fee

name: revoke-burn
why: 1 sompi to the principal, the rest burned as fee. The exit paths checked the output's scriptPubKey and never its value, which made the revocation key a DESTROY capability rather than a STOP one.
